findings.statement: The total of all valid invoice amounts in the invoices table is 202,682.05.
findings.method: SQL aggregation with SUM after cleaning string-formatted amounts
findings.code: SELECT SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(amount, '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)) as total_amount FROM invoices WHERE amount IS NOT NULL

data_quality_notes: 4 rows (5.0%) have null/missing amounts in the amount column
